title: Certificate of Origin
summary: Neo Logistics media note on Certificate of Origin (COO) documentation commonly required for preference claims and destination customs formalities.
impact: Exporters should confirm the correct COO type (preferential vs non-preferential) and issuing body before cargo cut-off. Neo’s CHA desk can guide document sequencing for Cochin/Chennai shipments.

title: Australian Fumigation
summary: Neo Logistics guidance note relating to Australian fumigation / biosecurity treatment expectations for outbound cargo.
impact: Shipments to Australia may need approved treatment certificates and timing aligned with sailing. Confirm commodity-specific AQIS/DAFF style requirements with Neo before packing completion.

title: CBIC Notification No. 47/2015-2020
summary: Neo-hosted reference to CBIC / FTP-era Notification No. 47/2015-2020 as published on the Neo Logistics media centre.
impact: Treat as a pointer only — open the official CBIC / DGFT text for operative clauses, amendments, and validity. Neo CHA can map relevance to your HS lines and shipments.

title: AEO programme — authorised economic operator (India)
summary: Public CBIC AEO framework helps trusted traders access facilitations (e.g. deferred payment / faster clearances depending on tier). Neo holds AEO-LO.
impact: Importers/exporters working with an AEO broker may see process facilitations, but shipments still need correct docs and self-assessment. Confirm current AEO benefits with Neo’s team — do not assume automatic duty concessions.

title: Self-assessment remains the importer/exporter’s duty
summary: Under India’s customs self-assessment framework, the importer/exporter is responsible for correct classification, valuation, and exemption claims on the Bill of Entry / Shipping Bill.
impact: Use Neo HS Finder shortlists and this digest only as prep. Final CTH, notifications, and exemptions must be confirmed by Neo’s licensed CHA before filing on ICEGATE.

title: ITC (HS) import policy — verify Free / Restricted / Prohibited
summary: DGFT ITC (HS) schedules set import policy conditions (Free, Restricted, Prohibited, etc.) on top of the customs tariff line.
impact: A CTH that looks tariff-clear can still be policy-restricted. Check live DGFT policy for your 8-digit line and licences before contracting cargo. Neo can flag common restricted categories for your trade lane.

title: Preferential origin & FTA documentation hygiene
summary: Claims under FTAs / preferential rates generally need valid origin proofs (e.g. COO / origin declarations under the relevant agreement) matching the commercial documents.
impact: Mismatched supplier declarations or stale COOs are a common assessment risk. Align invoice, packing list, and origin docs with Neo before seeking preference.

title: ICEGATE filing — confirm notifications on the date of import/export
summary: Duty, exemption, and procedure notifications change. ICEGATE / CBIC publications on the relevant date control the assessment — not website summaries.
impact: Bookmark official sources. Ask Neo CHA to validate any summary in this digest against the live notification text before you rely on it commercially.
